channel.title: Agent Daily
channel.description: New AI models, products and interesting discoveries. Published by Shixi Lin.

item.title: 2026-10-29 AI Agent — Voice Enters the Workflow
item.description: Live conversation, long-form transcription, and multiple-choice audio analysis each come with different requirements. This issue examines how models fit into work—and what their inference systems actually provide.

item.title: 2026-10-28 AI Agent — Models Become More Controllable
item.description: Small models move onto devices, world models respond to instructions, and video research leaves a clearer evidence trail. The question is not just what works, but who can use it.

item.title: 2026-10-27 AI Agent — Making Agent Work Easier to Check
item.description: Terra adds a visual automation option, while ThinkingBox trains against final task states. Editing tools, braille music, and classroom games make AI use more tangible and inspectable.

item.title: 2026-10-26 AI Agent — Turning Answers into Useful Work
item.description: Nanbeige releases a 33B teacher model, UMA adds scientific checkpoints, and Blender tools, Latin speech, and batch simulation turn model capabilities into tangible results.

item.title: 2026-10-25 AI Agent — Collaboration You Can Inspect
item.description: Microsoft opens thousand-agent experiments, while parametric CAD gains a shared control layer. Reading, music discovery, and collaborative art reach everyday users; local training and speech tools expose more checks.

item.title: 2026-10-24 AI Agent — Capabilities Beyond Chat
item.description: Kimi adds 3D creation, MiniMax releases weights, and an audio-only model explores natural conversation. Agents also reach TVs and image editors, with more concrete permission and failure checks.

item.title: 2026-10-23 AI Agent — Decisions Meet Actions
item.description: Decision APIs reach general availability, design models plan layouts, and password managers help authorize agents. Small projects reconnect code, voice messages, and workspaces.

item.title: 2026-10-22 AI Agent — Models Get Practical
item.description: Flint brings tool calling to local devices, Rerank 5 isolates relevant passages, and Claude Duet tries to organize work proactively. Small projects turn screens, speech, and an old game into new ways to interact.

item.title: 2026-10-21 AI Agent — Voice Meets Personal Tools
item.description: Voxtral 3 expands voice capabilities as small projects turn photos, notes, and desktops into places to act. Systems research asks which state is worth keeping.

item.title: 2026-10-20 AI Agent — Less Waiting and Dependence
item.description: New models cut API costs and refine deployment choices. Talking portraits, phone agents, and phonics stories put complex capabilities into more specific everyday experiences.

item.title: 2026-10-19 AI Agent — Results You Can Inspect
item.description: Material weights, speech turns, and brick connections gain inspectable entry points. From hiring simulations to philanthropic equity, the useful distinction is between evidence and commitment.

item.title: 2026-10-18 AI Agent — Turn Ideas into Something You Can Use
item.description: Models address speed and output costs, while tools turn text, photos, and speech into concrete actions. New entry points make 3D reconstruction and hardware projects easier to approach.

item.title: 2026-10-17 AI Agent — See Clearly, Then Act in Time
item.description: Open weights reach deployment, while memory and voice become dedicated components. Smaller tools give agents practical skills, from filing documents to finding weekend plans.

item.title: 2026-10-16 AI Agent — Open Models Find Their Roles
item.description: Fifteen updates: large models reach two-Mac setups, small models specialize in forecasting and speech, images guide layouts, assistants edit scores, and science workbenches add 3D views.

item.title: 2026-10-15 AI Agent — Show What Changed
item.description: Fourteen updates: new Ling and Grok voice models, quantized image weights, state-based agent tests, and creative tools for dubbing, learning, and animated mascots.

item.title: 2026-10-14 AI Agent — Choosing Where AI Runs
item.description: Fourteen updates: Argon expands access, Liquid releases local-agent weights, voice direction gets finer, and budgeting questions can stay on your Mac.

item.title: 2026-10-13 AI Agent — Picking Up Where Work Left Off
item.description: Thirteen updates: Meta introduces models with memory, MiniCPM explores phone deployment, workspaces can be saved, and music and spoken ideas become editable work.

item.title: 2026-10-12 AI Agent — Tools you can inspect
item.description: Twelve updates span inspectable sandboxes, planning benchmarks, interactive explanations, image search, language practice, and street-view audio tours.

item.title: 2026-10-11 AI Agent — Decisions beyond generated text
item.description: Twelve updates explore decision encoders, a neural-circuit desktop fly, reading maps, local meeting notes, and the cost of serving real workloads.

item.title: 2026-10-10 AI Agent — Small models enter creative tools and devices
item.description: Twelve updates span eight-step image generation, multimodal parsing, and Arabic transcription, plus tools that make parts, generate terrain, and give small devices a voice.

item.title: 2026-10-09 AI Agent — AI work needs verifiable results
item.description: Thirteen updates connect enterprise agents, local creative tools, model access, and research that examines whether generated results hold up.

item.title: 2026-10-08 AI Agent — AI moves beyond the chat box
item.description: Twelve updates cover lower-cost models, local decisions, playable games, voice input, and Windows hardware.

item.title: 2026-10-07 AI Agent — Models meet everyday work
item.description: This issue covers 13 updates on model previews, cross-media search, and image editing, alongside email, gardening, voice travel, and hardware experiments.

item.title: 2026-10-06 AI Agent — Testing agents
item.description: Twelve developments span model previews, enterprise agents, code review, and creative demos—with practical ways to inspect what each can do.

item.title: 2026-10-05 AI Agent — Agents enter everyday tools
item.description: Twelve developments bring agents to homemade devices, local media libraries, voice interfaces, and business data.

item.title: 2026-10-04 AI Agent — Better models, stronger checks
item.description: Twelve developments connect new models with retrieval, scientific reports, and video experiments—and bring the focus back to verifiable agent outcomes.

item.title: 2026-09-29 AI Agent — AI Enters Real Workflows
item.description: Sonnet and Holo4 gain capabilities, Shopify adds checkout tools, and small models and spare computers find new uses. The practical test is whether tasks can be completed with meaningful controls.

item.title: 2026-09-28 AI Agent — Less Wasted Work, More Action
item.description: Models shorten reasoning, game characters remember relationships, and samplers and robot hands put AI-related capabilities into physical interfaces. Twelve stories trace the distance from decisions to actions.

item.title: 2026-09-27 AI Agent — Diagrams Meet Physical Space
item.description: Assistants gain finer control over diagrams, while robots retrieve objects outside their view. As tools move into action, memory, execution environments, and decision scores need clearer boundaries.

item.title: 2026-09-26 AI Agent — AI Moves Beyond Chat
item.description: Copilot moves toward persistent work, while PixVerse and Horizon expand interactive creation. Local decisions, screen parsing, and faster visual inference supply more of the components needed to act.
